meta.title: Parts of a Plant Song | Grade 1 Science for Kids | Little Takhti
meta.description: Sing along with Takhti! Roots drink, the stem holds, leaves catch the sun and flowers make seeds. Find out what plants need and which plants we eat, then shout the answers in the quiz before the clock runs out. For Grade 1 children (ages 6 to 7). Little Takhti is also on Android.
